message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) for the described case.

Facts: Defendant bought industrial salt (non-food grade) and sold it as food salt (iodized) to consumers, making profit. This is selling food that does not meet safety standards. Under Chinese criminal law, there is a crime of "销售不符合安全标准的食品罪" (selling food that does not meet safety standards). Also possibly "非法经营罪"? But the main is selling unsafe food. The prosecution says that.

Check if any other charges: maybe "侵犯消费者权益罪"? Not typical. The crime is defined in Criminal Law article 144 (selling unsafe food). So answer: 销售不符合安全标准的食品罪.

Thus single charge.
